# Mews & GrowthBook
Date: 2026-09-09 | Duration: 53.95000076293945m

## Summary
The team discussed moving experimentation fully in-house by offboarding Spiro by Q1 next year and reducing dependence on limited internal developer capacity. GrowthBook was presented as an AI-first, API-driven platform supporting self-serve experimentation, visual editing, AI-generated variants, server-side and client-side testing, and reduced flicker through its Edge SDK proxy. Payload CMS integration, reusable experimentation blocks, Figma workflows, and HubSpot form editing were considered important for enabling marketing and growth teams to launch tests independently. Native BigQuery and Databricks integrations would support flexible metrics, funnel analysis, and retroactive reporting, while AI-assisted analysis could help teams interpret results. APIs and Claude integration could automate summaries and updates in Confluence and JIRA, with Slack notifications also planned. The current target is 12 experiments per quarter, with potential to scale substantially. Pricing discussions will use estimated seats and monthly sessions, with a pricing review planned for September 23 and budget decisions required in Q4.

## Keywords
CRO, experimentation, AI integration, GrowthBook, Spiro off-boarding, Payload CMS
